method.edge_launch: Harness spawns a fresh isolated Edge process/profile per run; application startup is timed. MCP/companion startup is separate.
method.actions: Repository MCP windows UI Automation for field entry and control invocation; foreground-guarded Enter submits the address bar.
method.verification: Read-only CDP observes only the dedicated benchmark tab: exact query, selected watch ID, player video ID, no active ad, and at least one second of unpaused media progress.
method.timing: Total starts before Edge spawn and ends at verified playback. Stage times include UIA discovery, actions, website/network/render waits and read-only verification. Cleanup and MCP startup are excluded.
method.repetitions: Fresh browser/profile per run; OS, Edge installation and network caches are not reset. No failed action or workflow is automatically retried.
method.limitations: Live YouTube, consent, sign-in challenges, ads, regional access, UI language and machine load affect results. No AI inference is measured. Small samples do not establish a stable p95.
